changelog.title: Analytics Dashboard (HD-6)
changelog.description: Handler Dashboard now includes completion trend chart, assignment difficulty heatmap, and class leaderboard with medals for top performers.

changelog.title: Activity Log (HD-4)
changelog.description: Live activity feed in Handler Dashboard shows student completions in real-time. Filter by student, see 'Active' badges on recently engaged students.

changelog.title: Mass Progress Tracking Sprint
changelog.description: Added saveProgress() and Mark Complete buttons to 200+ content files across all houses. Handler Dashboard now accurately reflects student completion.

changelog.title: All Houses Updated
changelog.description: Shield (compliance, crypto, access, games), Web (visualizers), Forge (Core 1 & 2), Cloud (applets), Script (presentations), Key (all content) now track progress.

changelog.title: Handler Status Persists
changelog.description: Handler (instructor) status now syncs to Firebase. Survives browser clears — just sign in to restore.

changelog.title: CLH Course Home
changelog.description: New dedicated landing page for Command Line Hacker with 31 modules across 7 tiers and progress tracking.
